title: Table Sessions
lead: Five short seats at the design table. Progress saves in this browser.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.body: You can open a real project with the Skill now. Start every return session with: read design-state first.
graduation.spell: Read design-state first. We are continuing Micro Scavenger. Diagnose any open symptom, then propose one single-variable experiment. Write files under ./micro-scavenger/.

sessions.title: Session 1: Open Create
sessions.story: You sit down with Micro Scavenger: a tiny scavenging race. The agent waits for a prompt.
sessions.task: Pick the prompt that can actually start a project.

options.label: 2p, 20 min, family. Feel: tense racing. Compare set collection vs push-your-luck. Write brief + design-state + skeleton to ./micro-scavenger/. No full rules yet.
Add art and a Kickstarter page first.

sessions.success: Strong prompts name players, time, feel, comparison, and output path.
sessions.fail: That prompt invites a mechanism dump or premature polish.

sessions.title: Session 2: Remember the table
sessions.story: A week later the chat is new. Three sticky notes are on the cork board. Which ones are Locked?
sessions.task: Select every Locked note. Leave hypotheses alone.

notes.text: HYP: hand size 4 might slow races

sessions.success: Locked stays locked without contradicting evidence.
sessions.fail: You grabbed a hypothesis or rejected item. Locked only.

sessions.title: Session 3: Diagnose first
sessions.goal: Route the symptom before changing rules.
sessions.story: Playtesters say the leader is obvious by round 3.

options.label: Nerf three cards and add a catch-up mechanic at once.
Route to runaway leader. Draft one falsifiable hypothesis.

sessions.success: One diagnostic, one hypothesis. Stacked fixes hide the signal.
sessions.fail: That stacks changes or ignores the symptom.

sessions.title: Session 4: One knob + cheapest fidelity
sessions.story: HYP-003: lowering hand limit increases discard fights.
sessions.task: Change only one knob, then pick fidelity.
sessions.fail: Either too many knobs or too much fidelity.

sessions.title: Session 5: Ship files + kill gate
sessions.goal: Outputs are files. Know when to stop.
sessions.story: Fun scores: 2.6, 2.7, 2.5 after three tests. Chassis feels flat.
sessions.task: Assemble the PnP file set, then pick the gate.
sessions.success: PnP files matter, and repeated low fun means restructure, not more chrome.
sessions.fail: Missing playable files or the wrong gate.
